en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town with a stone bridge crossing a river in the foreground. The bridge has metal railings and a gently curving road with a few pedestrians or cyclists. On both sides of the bridge stand multi‑story houses with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central European architecture. Behind them, more houses rise up a wooded hillside, and on the distant ridge a church or institutional building with a tall spire is visible. The scene is quiet and semi‑rural, with trees, gardens, and laundry lines. Some faint signage is visible on the facades but is not clearly readable.
